steps.en: Install dependencies and build the web app
steps.zh: 装好依赖并构建 Web 应用

steps.en: Mount the built bundle on a running cozy-stack
steps.zh: 把构建产物挂载到运行中的 cozy-stack

steps.en: Serves the Drive UI in the browser: file tree, upload, search by name
steps.zh: 在浏览器里提供 Drive 界面：文件树、上传、按名称搜索

steps.en: Shares a folder by link; the recipient accepts from an email and sees it in their own drive
steps.zh: 把文件夹分享成链接，收件人经邮件确认后在自己网盘里看到它

value.en: a Google-Drive-shaped file front door on your existing Cozy/Twake stack, with no second file server to babysit
value.zh: 在既有 Cozy/Twake 栈上得到 Google Drive 形态的文件门面，不必再多养一台文件服务器

sources: README.md master @ 2026-09-28 — 'Install': git clone / yarn install; 'Run in dev mode': yarn build, cozy-stack serve --appdir drive:/<project_absolute_path>/twake-drive/build/drive, app available at http://drive.cozy.localhost:8080/#/folder; 'What's Drive?': File tree, Files and folders upload, Files and folders sharing (via URLs), Files and folders search; 'Advanced case — Share and send mails in development': Alice shares a folder, Bob accepts via email button and sees it in his own twake
